second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 10 + Average 7 + Difficulty 6 = 23), pdf 68; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-23 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-5, II 6-12, III 13-21, IV 22-23). BLUE PRINT 10/7/6 = 23 = audited count. Answer side: keys 1-5 match by number; the rest belong to another version of the questions (analysis file). Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 23.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 68 (heading, LO 14, BLUE PRINT, pictures 1-2) 69 (pictures 3-5, passage, q6) 70 (q7-17) 71 (q18-23). A side 'Key Answers: 17' pdf 118. Folios = pdf page.

KEY SIDE: q1-q5 keyed by printed number (picture descriptions). q6-q23 empty + 'key belongs to another paper version'; pointer q22 <- the three 'III. 11)' lines (things I have done). The II-section key lines answer questions this lesson does not print (what hobbies are; examples; whom I would like to be like; a famous person).

Sections: s1 I q1-5 (each with its picture stimulus; text = instruction + printed picture label and answer box); s2 II q6-12 (passage stimulus st-evs-3-17-passage, verbatim English paragraph); s3 III q13-21 tick √ / X for good / bad habits -> vsa (a mark judging a habit, not a true/false statement; answer brackets removed from text); s4 IV q22-23 (4-5 sentences -> la).
FIGURES (v1.4 §14.10): five question-side pictures (pdf 68-69) -> five stimuli with one crop each (D4 path images/evs-3-17/stimuli/).
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 23 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 14, lo_source 'lesson_table'.

stimuli.text: Good habits help us live a better life. Waking up early is a good habit. Brushing our teeth everyday keeps us healthy. Saying "please" and "thank you" shows good manners. We should eat healthy food and sleep on time. Helping others is a kind habit. These small things make us good and happy people.
